claims.content: Non-C2 JU wants to receive situational awareness data—track and Reference Point data (air, surface/maritime, and land/ground surveillance data supplied in J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI=1) messages)—from the Surveillance NPG by monitoring it.

scope_contract.goal_statement: Non-C2 JU wants to receive situational awareness data—track and Reference Point data (air, surface/maritime, and land/ground surveillance data supplied in J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI=1) messages)—from the Surveillance NPG by monitoring it.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: Non-C2 JU monitors the Surveillance NPG and receives situational awareness data, including track and Reference Point data reported as Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance data in J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI=1) messages.
scope_contract.start_boundary: Non-C2 JU begins monitoring the Surveillance NPG for situational awareness data.
scope_contract.success_boundary: Non-C2 JU has received the situational awareness data (track and Reference Point data) transmitted on the Surveillance NPG.
in_scope_actions: Receive situational awareness data (track and Reference Point data)
Receive J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI=1) surveillance messages
excluded_adjacent_actions: Post-receipt processing or use of the data to support the platform mission
variant_dimensions: Surveillance category: Air vs Surface (Maritime) vs Land (Ground), with corresponding message type J3.2 vs J3.3 vs J3.5 (PTI=1)

claims.content: Non-C2 JU
The Non-C2 JU is capable of receiving situational awareness data (track and Reference Point data) from the Surveillance NPG.
The Non-C2 JU is restricted to a receive-only/monitoring-only role on the Surveillance NPG, i.e., it is prohibited from transmitting on this NPG.
The Non-C2 JU monitors the Surveillance NPG and receives situational awareness information.
The Non-C2 JU monitors the Surveillance NPG for situational awareness information.
The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness data from the Surveillance NPG, including track and Reference Point data provided in J3 series messages.

These data are received as J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track (PTI=1) messages for Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) surveillance data respectively.

Diverges from Step 3: The Non-C2 JU receives the J3.2, J3.3, or J3.5 situational awareness message with the Emergency Indicator (EMG IND) set to 1 or the Force Tell Indicator (FT IND) set to 1, indicating that the track is in an emergency status or force tell alert state.

Diverges from Step 3: When the received situational awareness data is nonreal-time, it is identified as nonreal-time with time tags provided, and nonreal-time track positions are not extrapolated; the Non-C2 JU still receives the situational awareness data.

missing_aspects: Evidence supporting that this alternative flow still satisfies the goal of receiving situational awareness data.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 2 when the Non-C2 JU receives a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) for a locally held remote track that is no longer being updated. The Non-C2 JU processes the message as a Drop Track Report, and the branch ends with the remote track dropped from local holding.

Diverges from Step 1 when, while monitoring the Surveillance NPG, a locally held remote track is no longer being updated and no J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report has been received. The Non-C2 JU may automatically purge the track after a system-selected time interval; for irregularly reported nonreal-time tracks, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall not be transmitted under this condition.

Diverges from Step 3 when the locally held Environment/Category of a track differs from the Environment/Category received in a J3.X or a J7.0 (ACT = 1) message for that track. The operator shall be alerted; the Environment/Category conflict is processed and resolved before any ID conflict, and if an Environment/Category conflict is detected no further processing to detect an ID conflict need occur.

missing_aspects: Explicit confirmation that the automatic purge constitutes the end of the exception flow branch.
Evidence supporting the claim that the branch 'ends' with the alert and precedence application.

claims.content: The Non-C2 JU has received remote surveillance track and point data transmitted on the Surveillance NPG in J3 series messages.
Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages have provided the Non-C2 JU with situational awareness and early warning information.
